expenditures.detail: THE DOCUMENTED EXCEPTION, SAID LOUDLY: this side does NOT close on the promoted per-period anchor. The single Schedule B row (04-05-14, 'SELF', 65.00) sums to 65.00 = Schedule B's own printed page subtotal AND its printed 'Total Expenditures Received' AND the cover's CUMULATIVE Column B (65.00). The cover's Column A 'Total this Period' expenditures is a SLASHED ZERO = 0, and the transaction is dated 04-05-14 — six months before this 'Seven days preceding the General Election' report (signed 10-28-14) — so the schedule restates the CYCLE, not the period, exactly the A6 pattern. Nothing was differenced across filings and no figure was nudged. Both in-kind conventions give the same sum (see in_kind_convention).

in_kind_convention: not applicable / both conventions tested and identical — this 2014 blank prints no in-kind column and no row on either schedule is marked in-kind, so monetary-only and monetary-plus-in-kind both give 65.00 on Schedule B and both give the same (zero itemized contribution rows) on Schedule A.

WHY sides.contributions IS 'empty-schedule' AND WHY THE $65 LOAN IS NOT PUBLISHED AS A CONTRIBUTION ROW (the A4/B3 ladder test, run and decided by the page): Schedule A carries exactly two written lines. Band 1 is a BANNER in the Name column — 'NONE (NO CONTRIBUTIONS)' — with no date and no amount (proved by the control crop). Band 2 is the filer's own memorandum: date '04-05-14', Name cell '(LOAN TO SELF)', address cell empty, Amount '65.' with raised '00'; he then carried that 65.00 into the schedule's printed 'Subtotal for this page' and 'Total Contributions Received'. The ladder decides against calling it a contribution, and it decides UNAMBIGUOUSLY: the cover's line 1 'TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED' prints a SLASHED ZERO in Column A (this period) AND a SLASHED ZERO in Column B (year-to-date) — both read 0 under the repo zero-glyph ruling — so the document states there were NO contributions in the period and NONE in the cycle, which is also what the filer wrote in his own hand on the schedule. This is the Witney 2010 (A4) outcome, not the Kirk 2010 / Grierson 2012 (B3) outcome: the loan is invisible in the itemized contribution layer BY DESIGN and is preserved verbatim here. Line 3 'Balance at Beginning of Reporting Period' prints '(65.00)' in accounting parentheses = -65.00, i.e. the filer books the self-loan as a debt, which is consistent with a zero contributions line.

FILER ARITHMETIC ON THE COVER, RETAINED VERBATIM AND NOT ADJUDICATED: the p2 ladder as printed is internally inconsistent. Line 3 = (65.00); line 4 'Total Contributions Received (From Line 1 Column A)' = (65.00) although line 1 Column A is a slashed zero; line 5 'Subtotal (Add lines 3 and 4)' = (65.00) although 3+4 = -130.00; line 6 'Total Expenditures Made (From Line 2 Column A)' = 65.00 although line 2 Column A is a slashed zero; line 7 'Balance at Close (Subtract Line 6 from Line 5)' = a SLASHED ZERO although 5-6 = -130.00. Nothing was recomputed or nudged. The two cells this transcription actually relies on — line 1 Column A/B (contributions) and line 2 Column B (expenditures) — are legible, unstruck and unambiguous.

NIL MARKS ON THIS FILING, read per line per the B2 caution: every nil on p2 is a SLASHED ZERO (lines 1 A and B, line 2 A, line 7) and therefore 0; there is no bare dash anywhere on the page, so the A3 blank-cover recovery was not needed.
